_readme: Search synonym groups, read by src/lib/search-synonyms.ts. Every term in a group finds every other: a query that names one of them matches listings that use any of them. Terms are folded at load (accents and case do not matter here) and the order inside a group does not matter. Add a group only for words that ALWAYS mean the same thing to a buyer; an ambiguous word ('flat', 'notebook') would widen unrelated searches. NO visa or itinerary terms, ever: eno.vn is a licensed marketplace and may not offer those services (CLAUDE.md, the edition split).

groups.note: Two-wheelers. 'motorbike' alone found 3 rows on production (2026-09-29). NOT 'scooter': measured the same day, it also names kick scooters (Airwalk stunt scooters in Sports, Spartan 3-wheel scooters in Toys), which then led the 'xe máy' and 'motorbike' results; the Honda scooters it was meant to reach say 'Xe máy' in their Vietnamese titles anyway.
Homes to rent or buy. 'condo' found 7 rows, all books (2026-09-29).
Portable computers. Not 'notebook': it is also paper.
